name: polykey
description: Modular on-screen keyboard for the Valve Steam Frame, drawn inside Steam's own keyboard popup

scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run format:check && npm run lint:py && npm run lint:sh && npm run lint:ci
scripts.lint:py: .venv/bin/ruff check sidecar scripts && .venv/bin/ruff format --check sidecar scripts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:py && npm run build
